summary: Closed Phase 19 (Markdown Tranche C -- Commands, Context, Docs and Rules) [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS]. Of 15 applicable Phase-15-confirmed anchor rows touching commands/context/docs/rules, direct per-row live inspection (5-line shingling plus manual window comparison, not trusted from the inventory's recorded heading) found only 2 genuinely collapsible: progress-file.md and metadata-file-return.md, each onto a sibling schema file's File Location section. The other 13 are mandatory command-structure.md section headings, complete worked YAML/JSON/bash examples a reader needs in place, a reference table that is itself the lookup content, or two deliberate documented mirror/parity copies (cslib/lean adversarial-verification.md) whose own text explains why they must stay content-identical. rules/ spot-checked directly, confirmed zero shared windows. NET-MD this phase: -6 lines; running total since Phase 17: -849 (a ~350x shortfall against the plan's stale -2,100 target, consistent with -- and strengthening -- Phase 18's own warning to read this role's allocation against the ~482-line confirmed ceiling rather than the stale figure). Observation-Duty findings, both inherited from Phase 18 and repaired, not introduced by this phase: a core/manifest.json provides.scripts registration gap for Phase 18's own 34 new capture files (sync-manifest-scripts.sh enumerates via git ls-files, invisible until staged), and a trailing-newline artifact on 15 of Phase 18's row7-*-SKILL.txt captures. Gate 8 (full battery) could not be exercised: the full verify-deploy.sh run exceeded its 540s bounded wait (exit 143) -- the same confirmed concurrent-session-contention finding Phases 16-18 each independently hit. Note: the phase-end handoff was written after that commit rather than before (an ordering slip), so it remains uncommitted pending the next commit opportunity rather than a prohibited second provenance-only commit. 1 of 20 plan phases remains: 20 (redeploy, full gate set, measured net accounting).
